While creating a Checkbox from JessieCode, the original setText method is restored.

The Checkbox constructor first calls the Text constructor with some raw
HTML as its content. The JessieCode parser overrides `Text.setText`
with a wrapper which escape HTML special characters.

This changes the Checkbox constructor to first restore the original
`Text.setText`, so that the right HTML nodes are produced, and then
switch back to the whatever setText method was set before the
constructor so that the content of the label is escaped if it came from
JessieCode.

Add unit tests for math/complex.js

Cover JXG.Complex constructor, all instance methods (toString, add,
sub, mult, div, conj, abs, angle), and the JXG.C namespace functions.
Includes edge cases for division by zero and negative inputs.

The div-by-zero tests document a bug: complex.js uses Math.eps
(undefined) instead of JXG.Math.eps, so the zero-guard for complex
division never triggers.

Fix division-by-zero guard in complex.js

Replace Math.eps (undefined) with JXG.Math.eps on both zero-checks
in the div() method. Without this fix the guard never triggers and
complex division by zero yields NaN instead of Infinity.

Add tests for cot, nthroot, log, log10, log2

Cover normal cases and edge cases that document existing bugs:
- cot(0) returns Infinity (no zero-guard)
- log(x, 1) returns Infinity (division by Math.log(1) = 0)
- nthroot(x, 0) computes 1/n before the n <= 0 guard

Fix edge cases in cot, nthroot, and log

- cot(x): return NaN when tan(x) is near zero instead of Infinity
- nthroot(x, n): move 1/n computation after the n <= 0 guard
- log(x, b): return NaN when b <= 0 or b = 1 (undefined base)

Fix calcLabelQuadrant returning undefined for angles near 315°

The lookup array had 7 entries but used modulo 8, so angles in the
range ~292.5°–337.5° produced index 7, returning undefined. The
missing "bot" (bottom, ~270°) position was absent, and "lrt"
(lower-right) was incorrectly placed at the 270° slot.

Add "bot" at index 6 and move "lrt" to index 7 to match the 8
documented label positions (rt, urt, top, ulft, lft, llft, bot, lrt).

Add test for projectCoordsToCurve domain boundary

Project a point beyond the right edge of a bounded functiongraph
and verify the returned parameter stays within the curve domain.
Exposes a bug where curve.maxX_glob (undefined) is used instead

Fix undefined curve.maxX_glob in projectCoordsToCurve

The minfunc closure referenced curve.maxX_glob (undefined property)
instead of the local variable maxX_glob. This meant the upper-bound
guard (t > maxX_glob) never fired, allowing the optimizer to evaluate
the curve outside its domain.

Add tests for Qag adaptive quadrature

First test: simple integral of x^2 (baseline).
Second test: integral of sin(x) over [0, pi] which forces multiple
bisection steps, exposing a bug where the second retrieve() call
uses wrong property names.

Fix wrong property names in Qag after second retrieve()

The second retrieve() call (line 1449) accessed wsObj.a_i, .b_i,
.r_i, .e_i, but retrieve() returns {a, b, r, e}. The first call
(line 1396) used the correct names. After the first iteration the
loop variables were all undefined, causing the adaptive bisection
to make decisions based on NaN comparisons.
